periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal outward tilt at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering directed medially toward the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent protrusion of the pink tongue from the oral cavity.
